hero.body: A community-owned tourism ecosystem built with the Ê Đê people of Đắk Lắk, where every experience is authentic, every benefit is local, and every journey leaves something behind worth keeping.

items.title: Direct Economic Empowerment
items.body: A peer-to-peer marketplace that lets travelers book and buy directly from Ê Đê providers, so the value of an experience stays with the household that created it.

items.title: Cultural Preservation
items.body: An interactive digital archive of Ê Đê history, traditions, and language, developed in collaboration with community members and reviewed by elders.

items.title: Environmental Stewardship
items.body: A carbon footprint tracker that channels offset contributions into conservation projects run and measured by communities in the Central Highlands.

items.title: Community Engagement
items.body: Governance structures that give the Ê Đê community a direct voice in how the platform evolves and how revenue is distributed.

culture.body: The Ê Đê are one of the largest ethnic minority groups in the Central Highlands of Vietnam, with a matrilineal social structure that has governed community life for generations. Their culture is preserved in the rhythm of the Cồng Chiêng, the craft of their weavers, and the enduring architecture of the longhouse.

items.title: Cồng Chiêng — UNESCO Intangible Heritage
items.body: Recognised by UNESCO in 2005, the Cồng Chiêng tradition is not merely music. It is a language that connects the living with their ancestors, performed around the fire at every gathering of significance.

items.title: The Longhouse — Architecture of Community
items.body: The Knă is the architectural heart of Ê Đê life. Extended families live together under one roof, governed by a matriarch. It is the gathering place, the memory keeper, and the source of this platform's name.

items.title: Weaving and Craft — Stories in Thread
items.body: Ê Đê textile traditions encode identity and story in every pattern. Each piece is woven by hand using techniques passed down through generations, carrying a meaning that no reproduction can replicate.

transparency.heading: Tracked, not promised.
transparency.body: Every transaction on KNĂ is recorded on a public ledger. Travelers see where their money goes. Communities see what they earned. Partners verify what they claim.
transparency.quote: “Transparency stops being a slogan when anyone can check.”

community.body: Cultural content is reviewed by community elders. Service providers are verified by community representatives. Revenue distribution decisions sit with a council of Ê Đê stakeholders, not a corporate board. KNĂ exists in service of the longhouse it is named after.

footer.tagline: A responsible tourism platform for the Ê Đê people of Đắk Lắk. Built for the BKI 2026 competition by students of Ho Chi Minh City University of Economics and Finance.
